config.intervention: replace c_v output with a rank-r least-squares map of x; q, k, q2, k2, rotary, squared-attention mixing, lamb and c_proj all run exactly as the model does
config.identity_check: c_v is LINEAR in x, so the full-rank map is c_v itself up to ridge and the full-rank arm must return ~100%
config.why_data_weighted: the useful rank-r approximation minimises error under the input covariance the module actually sees, not an unweighted norm on c_v.weight
config.scope: hooking c_v also changes the v1 block 0 exports, since v1 is that same pre-mix v -- this is attention with simplified values INCLUDING v1
